title: Wound Irrigation With Saline Versus Hypodilute-chlorhexidine After Cesarean Section (WISHES Study)
official: Wound Irrigation With Saline Versus Hypodilute-chlorhexidine After Cesarean Section: a Randomized Clinical Trial (WISHES Study)
summary: This investigator-initiated, open-label, randomized controlled trial will explore the effects of two treatment arms, comparing standard treatment with normal saline against Irrisept, a jet lavage solution containing a low concentration of Chlorhexidine Gluconate (CHG) at 0.05% in 99.95% sterile water for irrigation. The study aims to evaluate the impact on postoperative wound healing in patients who have undergone cesarean delivery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 or older
* Singleton pregnancy
* Planned cesarean delivery at gestational age 37 weeks or later at Loma Linda University Children's Hospital
* Planned post-operative follow up with Loma Linda OBGYN
* Speak English or Spanish
* At least one of the following medical complications: Obesity BMI\>= 30kg/m2, Diabetes, Spontaneous rupture of membranes, Intraamniotic infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Emergency cesarean delivery
